RUNMODE.TOOLTIP_DEFAULT: Default mode: production is allowed across the whole working temperature range; temperature only changes efficiency.
RUNMODE.TOOLTIP_CONTROL: Control mode: production only inside the best temperature range, and top-up heating runs while producing below the top-up line.

FORCEDRUN.TOOLTIP_ENABLE: Forced run: keep producing outside the working temperature range and keep heating. Materials, power, automation permission and building health still apply.
FORCEDRUN.TOOLTIP_DISABLE: Forced run is on. Turning it off re-evaluates production permission under the selected mode and keeps the current batch.

MECHANICAL.NAME: Mechanical Damage
MECHANICAL.TOOLTIP: The primary construction material is too soft; wear accumulated with actual production time caused this damage. Repaired normally, temperature is not reset.

OVERHEAT.NAME: Overheat Damage
OVERHEAT.TOOLTIP: The building body exceeded its overheat threshold. Repaired as an overheat repair, which resets temperature.

BOTH.NAME: Mechanical + Overheat Damage
BOTH.TOOLTIP: Both mechanical wear and overheat damage are present. Repair is handled as an overheat repair and resets temperature; this does not add an extra mechanical damage tick.

TEMPERATURE_ZONE.ACTIVE: Locked batch is inside the best temperature range
TEMPERATURE_ZONE.INACTIVE: Outside the best temperature range, or no locked batch
